summary: As a registered user, I want to reset my password so that I can regain access to my account
description: Users who forget their password need a self-service way to reset it via email.
acceptance_criteria:
Given I am on the login page
When I click "Forgot password" and submit my registered email
Then I receive a reset link by email within 5 minutes
Given I have a reset link
When I open it after 24 hours
Then I see an error that the link has expired
- The new password must be at least 12 characters long
- Submitting an unregistered email shows the same confirmation message

summary: As a shopper, I want to add items to my cart so that I can buy several products at once
description:
Shoppers browse the catalogue and add products to a persistent cart.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Clicking "Add to cart" adds the product with quantity 1
- Adding the same product again increases its quantity
- A cart can contain at most 50 distinct products
- Out-of-stock products cannot be added
- The cart is kept after logging out and back in
